digest.component_or_area: Cloud rate-limit sweep / Jira adapter transport layer
propositions: The Cloud rate-limit sweep's input file list is hardcoded in _step0_names() rather than derived, so a classified mutating method renamed or moved outside the four swept transport modules would not be caught by the completeness assertion.
Two classified mutating names (backend.py::set_relationship and backend.py::add_comment) currently exist outside the swept modules; both are pure same-name self.transport delegations and are benign.

An anti-drift guard must accept classified mutating names outside the sweep only when their body is a pure same-name transport delegation with unchanged arguments forwarded, rejecting any guard, retry, logging, transformation, or non-transport target.

The four swept transport file paths must be extracted into an explicit named constant (_SWEPT_TRANSPORT_MODULES) for reviewability and used by _step0_names() without widening the sweep via package-wide globbing.
